rubrics.justification: Describes an expanded Day-5 blastocyst with compact ICM, cohesive TE, and thinning zona consistent with 3AA; includes appropriate caveat about single-image limits, though some image-specific details are somewhat generalized.
Integrates age, prior live birth, BMI, FSH, PCOS, semen parameters, endometrial thickness, and lifestyle factors well, and connects them appropriately to prognosis and embryo quality.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to morphology and age; minor issue is some broad assumptions about euploidy/live birth conversions and a few speculative future-cycle comments.

Recommendations are largely consistent with IVF practice: elective single embryo transfer, luteal support, cautious interpretation of morphology, and selective rather than routine PGT-A at age 32. Minor deviations include some less-standard protocol speculation.

Provides practical next steps for current transfer and contingency planning for future cycles, including SET, luteal support, lifestyle advice, and when to investigate further; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
